drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Thank you for your feedback and for outlining your requests. Kindly see below for our updates to the draft Agreement in response to your comments:

- Base Salary: We have proposed an annual base salary of $310,000.
- Severance: In the event of termination without cause, severance will comprise 9 months’ base salary.
- Non-Compete: We have retained the 12-month restriction. Given the Executive’s anticipated access to sensitive operational and strategic information, we believe a full-year non-compete narrowly tailored to direct competitors is both customary and reasonably necessary to protect Vireo’s interests.

We welcome your thoughts and are happy to discuss further if required.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive a Base Salary of $310,000 per annum, payable in accordance with Company payroll practices, plus benefits.

3. SEVERANCE. Upon termination by the Company without cause, the Executive shall receive a severance payment equivalent to nine (9) months of Base Salary, subject to standard deductions and compliance with post-employment obligations.

4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not, for twelve (12) months following the termination of employment, directly or indirectly engage in any business that is in competition with the Company in any territory where the Company conducts business. This restriction is limited to direct competitors and is intended to protect the Company’s confidential information and business interests, to which the Executive will have substantial access in their capacity as Chief Operating Officer.
